From: Markus Klein <markus@redwood.com>

Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>, Sergio Alvarez <sergio@redwood.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:02:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap & recommended POC plan (owners + timeline)

Thanks for the call earlier — quick written recap so we have a single source of truth and clear owners. Please confirm and flag anything missing.

What we covered (agreed on call)
- Goal: Validate Redwood inference for SummitCare’s discharge-summary generation and PHI-safe redaction pipeline at 100k tokens/day throughput.
- Success criteria (proposal):
  * Latency: median generation latency <= 450ms for 1k token outputs
  * Quality: >85% pass rate on SummitCare clinical QA rubric (example rubric attached)
  * Privacy: Integration with SummitCare KMS and no raw PHI persisted by Redwood runtime
- Trial scope: 4-week sandbox with 3 integration checkpoints (week 1 ingest, week 2 baseline eval, week 4 final readout)

Owners / next steps (action items)
- Data & infra integration: Tom Reynolds (SummitCare) + Sergio Alvarez (Redwood) — target complete by 2027-04-20
- Evaluation plan & metrics: Marissa Cole (Redwood) + Alicia Gomez (SummitCare) — draft by 2027-04-15
- Security/compliance checklist: Markus to coordinate answers and provide sample configs by 2027-04-13
- Exec decision/readout: propose week of 2027-04-25 (planning below)

Attachments I’m including: SummitCare_MVP_acceptance_criteria_v1.docx, MutualActionPlan_SummitCare.xlsx

Proposed readout slots (please pick one):
- Tue 2027-04-26 09:00 PT / 12:00 ET
- Wed 2027-04-27 10:30 PT / 13:30 ET (preferred by our execs)
- Thu 2027-04-28 08:30 PT / 11:30 ET

If these look good I’ll lock the runbook and ask Marissa to share the evaluation matrix so your QA team can start baseline checks.

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Sr. Account Executive | Redwood Inference

Thanks Markus — appreciate the clarity. A few notes / clarifications from our side after syncing with clinical ops and security: 

1) Success criteria tweak: clinical QA rubric threshold we want to gate on is per-document pass rate >= 80% but average >= 88% (gives some allowance for edge cases). Can the evaluation matrix include both per-document and aggregate scoring?
2) Privacy: we need confirmation that the inference runtime will not write or persist raw PHI to any third-party telemetry. We’ve started the security questionnaire — I’m attaching our filled sheet (summitcare_security_questions.pdf) and cc’ing Elaine (procurement) for contracting/PO guidance.
3) Readout timing: Wed 4/27 10:30 PT works best for our clinical leadership. If you prefer Tue we can try to shuffle.

Also: please include estimated monthly run-rate if we graduate from POC to a 3-node dedicated pool (we’ll need that for budget approvals).

Alicia
Alicia Gomez
Dir, Clinical Ops | SummitCare Health

- Evaluation matrix: yes — Marissa will add per-document and aggregate scoring bands. I’ll ask for a version with columns for clinical pass/fail, severity, and notes so you can run your QA team against it.
- PHI persistence: short answer — Redwood runtime does not persist raw request/response payloads by default. For this trial we’ll set logging to redacted-only and wire KMS so any artifacts are encrypted and access-controlled. I’ll share a minimal security appendix by EOD.
- Pricing for 3-node dedicated pool: tentative estimate attached in the Drive link below (we’ll follow up with a formal quote once we’ve validated throughput).
